name: gradient-new-retrowave

frames.best_why: Frame 4 is the cleanest full view of the panel with the peach top and indigo base both clear.

tagline: Peach melts through mauve into periwinkle, bottom to top.
summary: A fixed three-stop gradient swatch: peach at the top, a mauve-pink band in the middle, and periwinkle blue along the bottom, delivered as a wide rounded rectangle.
appearance: A wide rounded rectangle on a black stage, filled with a smooth vertical blend. A pale peach sits at the top, passes through lavender-pink about halfway, and ends in a saturated periwinkle blue at the bottom edge.
behaviour: Static: nothing moves or responds. Every frame shows the identical gradient.
use_when: A warm-to-cool wash should sit behind content and set a retro, nightlife mood.
avoid_when: The three colours are fixed in the source, so restyling needs a code edit; no motion at all.
customise: className and style let you resize it and replace the background; the peach, mauve and periwinkle stops live in the file.
weight_why: One div with a single CSS gradient, no script, timers or animation.

a11y.note: Purely decorative fill with no controls, so keyboard, focus and labelling do not apply.

issues: Measured footprint is called full-bleed but the frames show a rounded card with black margins.
polish_why: Even, smooth blend and tidy corners; pleasant but a plain static swatch.
title: New Retrowave
